rationale: AuthMiddleware previously defaulted to SYLION_AUTH_MODE=dev when the variable was unset, which could allow dev-bypass behavior in production-like environments. The production roadmap requires backend enforcement and no legacy bypass, so staging and production now default to strict auth unless an operator explicitly overrides the mode.

steps: Revert AuthMiddleware._auth_mode to the prior default behavior.
Remove the production/staging default auth regression tests.
Run tests/test_auth_bootstrap.py to confirm the previous behavior is restored.

fidelity_test.description: Verify that unset SYLION_AUTH_MODE keeps dev behavior only outside staging/production.
pre_conditions: AuthProvider is reset to a temporary test database.
steps: Assert explicit dev mode still allows the local stale-bearer dev fallback.
Assert explicit strict mode does not fall back.
Assert production with SYLION_AUTH_MODE unset does not fall back.
Assert staging with SYLION_AUTH_MODE unset does not fall back.
fidelity_test.expected_outcome: Production-like environments default to strict auth and development keeps its dashboard convenience behavior.
